lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns across the mid-flank, typically featuring 4 to 5 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like alignment where the bands pass through the spot centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left foreground displays a high-density clustering of smaller, less-regular high-luminance spots compared to the main lateral flank patterning.
